targets.rawSql: SELECT dc.country_name, sum(fso.order_amount) AS revenue FROM gold.fact_sales_orders fso JOIN gold.fact_shipments fs ON fs.order_id = fso.order_id JOIN gold.dim_destination_country dc ON dc.country_code = fs.destination_country_key WHERE fso.updated_at > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY dc.country_name ORDER BY revenue DESC

panels.title: On-time delivery rate (avg time to destination, hours)

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(time_to_destination_seconds) / 3600.0 AS avg_hours FROM gold.fact_shipments WHERE is_delivered

SELECT p.name, f.current_stock, f.initial_stock FROM gold.fact_inventory_snapshot f JOIN gold.dim_product p ON p.product_id = f.product_id AND p.dbt_valid_to IS NULL WHERE f.is_below_restock_threshold AND f.snapshot_date = current_date
